eyebrow: ServiceNow DevOps, Testing & Deployment · Chapter Four
subtitle: Lesson 14 · Automated Test Framework (ATF)

code:
UI Test:                          Server-side Test:
open form -> set field ->         call Script Include method,
submit -> verify UI result        OR create/modify a GlideRecord
                                   -> verify the logic's result
directly
caption: Logic tested in isolation — faster, and no UI to account for.

code:
Test Step: call Script Include method
  method: isEquipmentAvailable(equipmentId)
  input:  a known equipment record
  assert: return value === expected (true/false)
caption: Checks the logic's contract — right answer for a known input.

code:
Test Step: create GlideRecord under known conditions
  (the conditions a before-insert Business Rule checks)

assert: insert was aborted
   OR   field X now equals the expected value
caption: Confirms server-side enforcement actually worked.
